title: A summer school where books grow on trees
description: A little girl stands beneath a tree in a village in Jharkhand’s Khunti district, her eyes fixed not on the leaves above her, but on the pages swaying between the branches. Around her, other children gather, reading aloud from worksheets and stories that have turned the tree into a classroom.
